channel.title: OpenVoice Dispatch
channel.description: Notes on local-first voice dictation, vibe coding, and the trade-offs of running speech-to-text on your own machine instead of someone else's.

item.title: Introducing OpenVoice: voice dictation that stays on your machine
item.description: Wispr-Flow-class dictation for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Free, open-source, runs entirely on your hardware. Here's what shipped and why we built it.
item.author: noreply@apexaios.io (The OpenVoice maintainers)
